query: The Relationship Between Variable Selection and Data Augmentation and a Method for Prediction

record.title: The Relationship Between Variable Selection and Data Agumentation and a Method for Prediction
record.abstract: We show that data augmentation provides a rather general formulation for the study of biased prediction techniques using multiple linear regression. Variable selection is a limiting case, and Ridge regression is a special case of data augmentation. We propose a way to obtain predictors given a credible criterion of good prediction.
